candidates.purpose: Reference architecture for websocket ingestion, in-memory sliding market state, historical backfill, MFE/MAE outcome tracking and risk-context tagging.
candidates.latencySuitability: HIGH with Polygon/Massive entitlement; architecture is websocket-first but production costs/entitlements are external.
candidates.license: README states MIT; GitHub repository metadata has no detected license object, so legal verification is required before code reuse.
candidates.maintenance: Created 2025-12-02; last push 2025-12-21; not sufficiently current for direct integration.
candidates.docsTests: README is detailed and documents architecture/outcome analytics. No test directory visible at repository root in this sweep.
candidates.securityNotes: Requires external POLYGON_API_KEY; never expose credentials client-side. In-memory state is lost on crash. RTH-centric calculations require adaptation for TAGX extended-hours use.
candidates.lookAheadBiasRisk: MEDIUM. Historical backfill and outcome analytics must preserve event-time boundaries; useful pattern but must not leak future bars into replay.

marketAudit.finding: The mover cohort was being observed, but the authoritative persistence features were silently removed from production by a competing schema-v2 writer. This damages Cross-Validate/Challenge quality and can alter rankings or cause stale/partial interpretation. Fix data lineage before changing thresholds.

productionChange.problem: Two scheduled workflows wrote tag/data/extended-hours.json. tagx-extended-hours.yml produces schemaVersion 3 with 5m/15m/30m velocity, persistence slope/pass, velocity quality and bar anomaly fields. tagx-extended-hours-native.yml concurrently produced schemaVersion 2 and could overwrite those features.
productionChange.change: Retired tagx-extended-hours-native.yml from scheduled production. It is manual-only and read-only for provenance. tagx-extended-hours.yml is now the sole authoritative scheduled producer.
expectedImpact: restore persistence and multi-horizon velocity fields consistently
improve deterministic ranking and replay traceability
reduce false positives caused by interpreting a single 15m velocity without quality/persistence context
productionChange.championChallenger: No scoring threshold changed. Current ranking remains champion; restored schema-v3 features are evidence inputs until multi-case validation supports weighting changes.
